chunks: Visiting the graves of the martyrs.
When you wish to visit the graves of the martyrs, then say:
Peace be upon you for your patience; how excellent is the final abode.

key_terms.الدَّارِ: the abode; the final dwelling, referring to the hereafter
key_terms.السَّلَامُ: peace; a greeting of peace and invocation of safety
key_terms.الشُّهَدَاءِ: the martyrs; those who were killed in the path of Allah
key_terms.زِيَارَةُ: visitation; the act of respectfully visiting a sacred or honored grave
key_terms.صَبَرْتُمْ: you were patient; enduring steadfastly in faith and trial
key_terms.عُقْبَى: final outcome; the ultimate end or result

ai.seo_question: What should be said when visiting the graves of the martyrs?
ai.summary: This text teaches a visitation formula for addressing the graves of the martyrs. It honors their patience and points to the excellence of their final abode, expressing reverence, remembrance, and supplication in the context of ziyārah.
